name: Joy and thankfulness
description: Seven days to practise gratitude and find joy that holds up even on ordinary or hard days.

days.title: Count the gifts
days.note: David tells his own soul not to forget God's kindness.
days.devotional:
Gratitude is partly remembering. David lists what God has done: forgiving, healing, rescuing, crowning with love.

Try writing down three gifts from this week before you close the app.
days.prayer: Lord, I don't want to forget Your kindness. Thank You for these gifts today.
questions: What three gifts can you name from this week?
Which of God's kindnesses do you most easily forget?

days.title: Joy in prison
days.note: Paul writes about joy while in chains.
days.devotional:
Paul's circumstances are hard, yet joy runs all through this letter. His joy is rooted in Christ, not in comfort.

Joy and difficulty can live in the same day.
days.prayer: Jesus, root my joy in You, not in how my day goes.
questions: Where is it hard to find joy right now?
What could Christ be doing even in that?

days.title: The one who came back
days.note: Ten men are healed; one returns to say thank you.
days.devotional:
All ten received the gift. Only one turned back to thank the Giver, and Jesus notices.

Thanksgiving turns a blessing into a meeting with God.
days.prayer: Lord, make me the one who comes back to say thank You.
questions: What has God done that you have not thanked Him for?
Who could you thank this week?

days.title: Thanks in every season
days.devotional:
Paul asks for thanks in all circumstances, not for all circumstances. There is always something to thank God for, even when not everything is good.

Gratitude is a habit built a day at a time.
days.prayer: Father, teach me to give thanks in every circumstance, even this one.
questions: What is hard to give thanks in right now?
What good can you still find in it?

days.title: Joy that is full
days.note: Jesus talks about remaining in His love so that joy may be complete.
days.devotional:
Jesus wants His joy to be in us, and complete. It grows as we stay close to Him and love one another.

Joy is not only a feeling to wait for. It is a fruit that grows.
days.prayer: Jesus, let Your joy be in me today, and spill over into how I love others.
questions: What helps you stay close to Jesus day to day?
How could you share joy with someone today?

days.title: Content in all things
days.note: Paul describes learning to be content.
days.devotional:
Contentment, Paul says, was something he learned, through both plenty and need. The secret is the strength Christ gives.

Gratitude and contentment grow together.
days.prayer: Lord, teach me contentment. Thank You for what I have today.
questions: What makes contentment hard for you?
What are you grateful for that money cannot buy?

days.title: A song of praise
days.note: A short psalm calling everyone to come before God with thanks.
days.devotional:
This psalm is an invitation: come in with thanksgiving, because God is good and His love lasts.

End this week by praising God for who He is, not only for what He gives.
days.prayer: God, You are good and Your love lasts forever. I praise You today.
questions: What is one thing about God's character you are thankful for?
How will you keep practising gratitude?
